correctness.rationale: For a vertex in part V_i, the closed-neighborhood intersection is exactly 1+b-b_i when selected and b-b_i when unselected. This yields the iff criterion immediately. Existence of a size-s packing above k reduces to lower quotas t=s-k+1 in every part; the necessary inequalities t<=min n_i and rt<=s are also sufficient because total residual capacity is N-rt. Maximizing the feasible size gives the closed formula. Exhaustive replay through order 9 checks 1,680,156 subsets, all coefficients, and the known bipartite specialization.

value.rationale: Limited packing is an established facility-location/security invariant and maximum k-limited packing is computationally hard even on broad bipartite/split classes. Complete multipartite graphs are a natural dense structured family. The result gives a complete feasible-set description, exact coefficient enumerator, and a closed formula generalizing the published complete-bipartite value, so it is more than a routine substitution or a tiny finite computation.
